records.title: Becas de Excelencia del Gobierno de México para Extranjeros (Mexican Government Excellence Scholarships for Foreign Students)

validation.notes:
NO OFFICIAL LOGO EXISTS FOR THIS AWARD ON ITS OFFICIAL PAGE. I did prove the page and then proved the absence of a usable mark. The official_source_url https://www.gob.mx/amexcid/acciones-y-programas/becas-para-extranjeros-29785 is LIVE (HTTP 200, h1 = 'Becas de Excelencia del Gobierno de México para Extranjeros 2026') but is behind a JS bot-challenge: plain webfetch and PowerShell both received only a 1,902-byte 'Challenge Validation' interstitial, so I rendered it in a real browser to read the actual DOM. Exhaustive DOM inspection of that official page found NO AMEXCID logo and no programme logo. Specifically: the primary navbar brand is an empty div -
- and the agency sub-navbar brand is PLAIN TEXT, not an image: amexcid. The only 24 elements and the only url() background-image on the entire page are enumerated in the rejected list below: portal UI icons, social-media share icons, survey widgets, decorative hero art, a decorative CTA banner, and the gob.mx portal's own wordmark. The one candidate brand mark, framework-gb.cdn.gob.mx/gobmx/img/logo_blanco.svg (1535x476, alt 'logo gobierno de méxico'), is the shared gob.mx PORTAL chrome: it is the .logo-main background shared by every agency page on the platform, it is served from the generic framework CDN rather than from the award's own identity, it is a white (logo_blanco) wordmark that is invisible on white backgrounds, and it represents the whole portal rather than AMEXCID or this scholarship. Taking it would be exactly the rejected 'unrelated mark on a shared CDN' case, so image_url stays null. Adjacent official Mexican government hosts are unreachable from here: https://amexcid.sre.gob.mx/ and https://sigca.sre.gob.mx/ (the scholarship's own application portal) both return a Perfdrive CAPTCHA wall instead of content, so no logo could be read from them either. I did not use embamex.sre.gob.mx embassy pages or aggregator/third-party listings, which would not prove the programme's official mark.

records.title: TDTU Scholarship for International Students (2026-2027 Academic Year)

validation.notes:
The shard's official_source_url (https://admission.tdtu.edu.vn/en/undergraduate/Scholarships, live HTTP 200, canonical self-reference, title 'TDTU Scholarship for International Students in the 2026-2027 Academic Year | Admission') contains NO logo image in its content at all - a full inventory of that page yields only the preloader gif, the site header logo, a 'Tiếng Việt' link, a search icon, and stock admission-illustration tiles. Its only logo is the sub-brand header mark /sites/admission23/files/Admission-2023/Logo-admission.png, which I downloaded and measured at just 120x70 px - too small to serve as the record's image (favicon-adjacent quality). I therefore moved one level up the section 7 hierarchy to the university's own main site tdtu.edu.vn (the parent domain of the admission host, and the domain named by the record's official_source 'Ton Duc Thang University (TDTU)'), which publishes the university brand mark in its footer brand block:

Ton Duc Thang University

19 Nguyen Huu Tho Street, Tan Hung Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

. Verified by direct download: HTTP 200, image/png, 534x534 px, 46,394 bytes. Rendered and visually inspected: the official TDTU mark - the interlocking red-and-blue 'TDT' monogram, the ® symbol, and the bilingual wordmark 'ĐẠI HỌC TÔN ĐỨC THẮNG / TON DUC THANG UNIVERSITY'. Exact identity match for the awarding institution. It is the footer organisation brand mark, not UI chrome, not an icon, not a favicon, and at 534x534 it is nowhere near favicon-sized. The same asset is also published identically on international.tdtu.edu.vn (/sites/international/files/uploadfile/logo_2.png, byte-identical size), corroborating that it is the standing university logo rather than a page-specific graphic.
